past.title: Thursday Night Cruise-In at the DQ | July 2nd
past.body:
(Weekly) Thursday Night Cruise-In at the DQ

Thursday, July 2nd | 3p

Located at Dairy Queen - 4024 Portsmouth Blvd., Chesapeake

So if you're not doing anything on Thursday afternoons get those cars out and come up to DQ. You can go in and order food and bring it out to eat. Make sure you bring a chair because they've taken the tables and chairs in. People start getting there around 2:00 and hang out for 3-4 hours or so. The weather is starting to get nice and there's not a whole lot of places we can go. This is one of the few places we can.

past.title: Classic Cars, Coffee, & Cones | June 27th
past.body:
(Weekly) 2026 Classic Cars, Coffee, & Cones at the Portsmouth Olde Towne Farmers Market

Saturday, june 27th | 10a-1:30p

Located at the Courthouse and High St., Portsmouth.

Join us for informal Classic Cars & Coffee at the historic Olde Towne Farmers Market every Saturday through December 20th. Classic cars get FREE up-front, car-show-style parking and FREE gourmet coffee for the drivers. Great spot to bring the spouse and family, 50+ vendors with fresh produce, grilled items, baked goods, sweets, juices, confections, even handmade jewelry and artisan items. Always something different, and very welcoming! Just flag down anyone in a yellow traffic safety vest and our deputy sheriffs will guide you to a prime spot.

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!

past.title: Cars and Coffee Norfolk | June 27th
past.body:
(4th Sat) Cars and Coffee Norfolk February Meet

Saturday, June 27th | 9-11a

Located at Tidewater Tech, 4535 E Princess Anne Rd., Norfolk.

Monthly car meet on the 1st and 4th Saturdays of every month.

  • 1st Saturday Located at Greenbriar Mall

  • 4th Saturday Located at Tidewater Tech

All cars, motorcycles, bicycles, etc. welcome! Free coffee and doughnuts! Park in the side lot (please only take one space).

ABSOLUTELY NO: Revving, burnouts, loud music. Be on your best behavior and respect the location.

past.title: Colonial Car Scene Meet | June 26th
past.body:
(Weekly) Colonial Car Scene Meet

Friday, June 26th | 7-10p

Located at Bruster's Real Ice Cream, 5289 John Tyler Hwy., Williamsburg.

FRIDAY! FRIDAY! FRIDAY! Friday nights, come on out and have a good time, trying get the dust off the camera with the sun being out for a good bit at the start and need some new photos for the flyers. As always respect the spot, it's been weeks since I've been able to come out and don't want to show up just to see some ding dongs being ding dongs ruining it.

Keep in mind that being around in ice cream establishment there are going to be children so please remain respectful! Hope to see you all out there this week.

No Revving - No Burnouts - No Loud Music. Pick-up after yourself. Hope to see you all there. 

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!

past.title: NK Cruisers Cruise In | June 19th
past.body:
[1st & 3rd fri] NK Cruisers Cruise In

Friday, June 19th | 6-9p

Located at Rosie's Lot 7, 10515 Colonial Downs Pkwy., New Kent.

NK Cruisers meet the 1st and 3rd Friday 6-9p or until the last person leaves (November-March). NK Cruisers, a local car enthusiast and cruise-in group bringing the car community together between Richmond and Williamsburg. The focus is New Kent, Charles City, and Lanexa but we welcome all folks from all areas. All years, makes, models, years, cars, truck, motorcycles, golf carts, boats, tractors, and trailered vehicles always welcome. Inclement weather cancels. For more information email: nkcruisers@gmail.com and NK Cruisers Facebook page for announcements and information. www.facebook.com/groups/277456353510653/

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!

past.title: Cars and Coffee Chesapeake | June 13th
past.body:
[2nd sat] Cars and Coffee Chesapeake

Saturday, June 13th | 8a-11a

Located at Everbowl - 1244 Greenbrier Pkwy #570, Chesapeake, VA 23320

Team Ultraspeed and Everbowl are teaming up to bring you the best Cars and Coffee meets in the area! Come hangout and help us close out the 2025 Car Season. We are collecting non-perishable goods this month for the Foodbank of Southwestern VA. Give Thanks, Give Food. Help us drive out hunger! We are also still collecting new kids pajamas to support Pajama Jams. Pajama Jams collects these items throughout the year in preparation for their important Annual Holiday Pajama Drive for Hampton Roads. Please drop off your donations at the Red Ultraspeed tent, you can write it off on your taxes! We are now a 501(C)3! You won't want to miss this, so mark your calendars and we'll see you there! 

More info
